name: mspring-theme
description: QwQNT 主题，优雅 · 粉粉 · 细致
author: MUKAPP

scripts.clean: rimraf dist src/style.min.css src/heti-addon.js src/heti-m.css mspring-theme.zip
scripts.build:heti: npm run build:heti:css && npm run build:heti:js
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:heti && (sass src/style.scss | postcss -o src/style.min.css) && node pack.js
scripts.dev: npm run build:heti && (sass src/style.scss | postcss -o src/style.min.css) && nodemon --watch src --watch vendor/heti -e scss,js --exec "npm run build:heti && (sass src/style.scss | postcss -o src/style.min.css)"
